pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take: **Zach, you call yourself 'Mustard Boy,' but let me tell you something: right now you're just plain bland, and this World Cup shows you have the soccer acumen of a soggy hot dog bun.** You're sitting in fourth place with a laughable 43 points, largely because you put all your Tier 1 hopes in Brazil, expecting them to carry a team filled with mediocrity. Devin, look at me — you dared to draft Bosnia, and yet here you are leading the pack with Spain leading the charge. This isn't luck; it's a miracle wrapped in a fluke, but at least you're not the back alley amateur 'The Noisemaker' Rafe is. Kid, you've got a grand total of 29 points and an uncanny knack for selecting teams that didn't even qualify. As for you, 'Bubba G' Gunner, despite having France in your arsenal, you still find yourself trailing behind Gross Pepper Devin. How's that taste, huh? This game isn't just about having the best teams, it's about making choices that reflect intelligence and sheer willpower. I don't see much of either in this so-called competition.
